verdict_text:
NO

The plan computes `tv2 = ft2 - base` only after `add_` has already written `base + 0.4*tv1` back into the base MLP tensors, so the second subtraction uses the already-merged tensor as the "base" instead of the original base. This makes `tv2 = ft2 - (base + 0.4*(ft1-base))` rather than `ft2 - base`, producing `out = base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base-0.4*(ft1-base))`, which is not the required `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)`. This directly violates the "Why it is meaningful" ordering requirement and Required-result step 2's formula, since ft2's task vector is not taken against the unmodified base.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
